problem_text:
A logistics company needs to route 5 shipments through 5 different distribution centers.

Each shipment must pass through a specific sequence of distribution centers for processing,
where each processing step is represented as (Center, Hours needed),
specifying the distribution center where the processing occurs and the duration required.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the processing steps must be completed.

Shipment details:
* S1 requires the sequence: (C4, 6) → (C2, 2) → (C1, 9) → (C3, 6) → (C5, 4)
* S2 requires the sequence: (C4, 10) → (C5, 6) → (C1, 2) → (C3, 10) → (C2, 5)
* S3 requires the sequence: (C2, 1) → (C4, 7) → (C5, 8) → (C1, 6) → (C3, 4)
* S4 requires the sequence: (C4, 1) → (C3, 8) → (C5, 5) → (C1, 1) → (C2, 9)
* S5 requires the sequence: (C5, 9) → (C2, 5) → (C1, 2) → (C3, 3) → (C4, 7)

Each processing step must run continuously once initiated without interruption,
and each distribution center can only handle one processing step at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing schedule for all shipment steps across the centers
so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
